GoHighLevel website · Zeotein Google Site

Zeotein Google Site Kit

The 12 Nov rebuild: a bright, zeotein.com-style shop with real product options (Starter Kits, 30-day bulk bag, stick packs), eight single-ingredient pages and an on-site cart, so a shopper can put a blend and a single ingredient in one order and check out once on Shopify. No browsing on zeotein.com, no $89.99 renewal, no Zeolite. Seventeen blocks, built and tested, ready to paste.

The rating line

The rebuilt Home, Cacao and Vegan pages add a store-wide rating line using the figure Zeus confirmed: 4.9 from 155 reviews. Product pages say across Zeotein because the 155 reviews cover the whole store, not one product. Today's live pages show no overall rating. The figure matches zeotein.com. The three review quotes are verified Judge.me reviews, quoted as written.

Approved. Use the standard Home, Cacao and Vegan blocks. The before and after below stays on record.

About 45 minutes in GoHighLevel

Install

Zeus installs; nothing here is for Dana. The full packet is google-site/INSTALL-PACKET.md. Eight pages already exist with the right paths; nine are new. Every block changed, so all 17 are pasted. Ticks are saved in this browser only.

Faster: let Claude on your PC do the install

This kit was built in a cloud session, which can't reach your browser. On your PC, open the Claude desktop app, start a session that runs on your computer with Claude in Chrome connected, and paste this prompt. Or do the steps below yourself.

    • Zeus installs from google-site/INSTALL-PACKET.md on the branch: every page, path, where the code goes, the exact file, the order and the checks. The steps below are the short version.
    • Sites → Websites → Zeotein Google Site → add a page for each, with these exact paths: /single-ingredients, /collagen, /bone-broth, /hemp-protein, /pumpkin-seed-protein, /cacao-powder, /mct-oil-powder, /sea-moss, /lions-mane. The blocks link to these paths, so a different path breaks the links.
    • Open the page in the builder and remove the sections that are there now (clone the page first if you want a copy).
    • Add one full-width section with one row and one column. Set section, row and column padding to 0 and background to none.
    • Add a Custom JS/HTML element (newer builders call it Code). Paste that page's block from Page blocks. Save.
    • Page settings → SEO meta data: paste the page's title and description. Save.
    • Website settings → Tracking code → Head. Keep the Google Ads tag AW-18130788543, the Meta pixel and Clarity. Replace the old Zeotein snippet with this one and save. Leave the Body tracking code as it is.
    • It starts with <meta name="robots" content="noindex, follow">, so the shop stays out of Google Search while ads still run. A noindex line you added by hand can stay (a duplicate is harmless) or go.
    • On a phone and a desktop: Cacao → Starter Kit, Every 6 weeks → Add to cart; then Single Ingredients → Sea Moss 1/2 lb → Add to cart. The cart should show $76.99 (then $99.99 per delivery) and $59.99, subtotal $136.98.
    • Press Checkout. Shopify checkout should list both items and say "First payment $76.99, then $99.99 every 6 weeks". Stop there: no details, no payment.
    • Claude runs qa/e2e_cart.js, qa/link_check.py and the compliance prescan against https://shop.zeotein.com and reports back.
    • No final URL moves to shop.zeotein.com until the hold lifts. The table in Google Ads is ready for that day.

    • Paste one block per page

    Page blocks

    Each block is self-contained: fonts, styles, header, page, footer and script. Copy exactly; don't edit inside GoHighLevel. Change prices or links in src/config.json and rebuild instead.

    Two layers, run on every built page

    Compliance

    Layer 1 is your zeotein-compliance-scrub prescan (Google healthcare, FDA/DSHEA, FTC patterns) run on page text, alt text, attributes and schema. Layer 2 is your house rules from the Guardrails, the Headlines Test Queue, the Ad Comment Replies rules and the Decisions log.

    PageCriticalHighHouse rulesFacts vs locked specFDA lineImages

    Every High hit is the word "guarantee" in the 30-day money-back terms, or "not guaranteed" in the shipping policy's legal text. The Guardrails approve the money-back guarantee for ads, so these are classed compliant. There are no outcome promises anywhere on the site, and no structure/function claims beyond the plain composition facts.
